already_running: Vigil Trophies is already running in the tray.
detect_intro: Vigil found these folders with trophies:
detect_none: No emulator or port was found in the usual places. Use “Detected sources → Add a folder…” to pick one.
detect_question: Watch them? The agent only reads these folders; it never changes anything.
detect_update_intro: This version of Vigil recognizes more game folders. Here is what it found on this PC:
err_denied: the request was denied on the website
err_unexpected: something went wrong (details in the log)
folder_status_error: Could not read everything in it
folder_status_gow3_unidentified: Game not identified: set the game folder in the God of War III launcher. Nothing is sent until then.
folder_status_unlinked: Waiting for this PC to be linked
folder_unknown: That folder does not look like RPCS3, shadPS4 or bbport.
linked_ok: This PC is linked as %s. Trophies now sync on their own.
open_browser: Confirm the code %s in your browser.
pick_folder: Pick the folder of RPCS3, shadPS4 or bbport (its user folder)
src_gow3-log: God of War III — PC port
state_offline: No connection to the server: %d waiting, retrying
stop_more: Vigil will not offer it again when it looks for folders. To watch it again, open Manage folders, then “Folders you stopped watching”, or add it by hand.
stop_text: This folder will no longer be watched. Its files and the trophies already synced are kept.
token_refused: Not linked (the website removed this PC)
unauthorized: The website no longer accepts this PC. Choose “Link this PC again”.
update_available: Version %s of Vigil is available (you have %s). The download opens in your browser; install it when you are ready. Your link, settings and pending trophies are kept.
update_body: Version %s is available. Click to download.
update_dev: This is a development build (%s): updates are not checked.
update_failed: Could not check for updates now. Check your connection and try again later.
update_none: You have the latest version of Vigil (%s).
welcome: Vigil Trophies is in the tray (next to the clock). Click the icon and choose “Link this PC”.
